source: Chamonix Brévent-Flégère piste map 2026-27 (skimap.org map 46151, the resort's PDF): run labels are real text printed in the run's colour (green, blue, red, black); each map run name was matched to its label's colour by script, and the labels that script could not place were read by eye from enlarged crops
names_note: Map labels shorter than the OpenStreetMap names: Cornu = Col Cornu, C.Bozon = Charles Bozon, Vioz = Combe Vioz, Retour Brévent = Retour Brévent Bleue, Accès TK = Accès TK Floria, the green TK 2000 loop = Verte 2000. Retour Planpraz, Retour Stade and Variante Vioz have no label on the map.

not_runs.Boarder Cross: snowpark and boardercross at La Flégère
not_runs.Mont Blanc Legend: racket (snowshoe) and discovery trail, not a ski run

lifts_source: lift names printed on the same map, without their type prefix (TPH cable car, TC gondola, TSD/TS chairlift, TK drag lift); TK 2000 is the map's Altitude 2000 drag lift
